mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user (login_name, user_name, email, status, password) VALUES (#{loginName}, #{userName}, #{email}, #{status}, #{password})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user set login_name = #{loginName}, user_name = #{userName}, email = #{email}, status = #{status} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND del_flag = 0
UPDATE sys_user set del_flag = 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE sys_user set status = #{status} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND del_flag = 0
mapper.select: SELECT user_id, login_name, user_name, email, status FROM sys_user WHERE del_flag = 0 ORDER BY user_id
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_user WHERE login_name = #{name} AND del_flag = 0
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_user WHERE email = #{email} AND del_flag = 0
SELECT user_id, login_name, user_name, email, status FROM sys_user WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND del_flag = 0
SELECT user_id, login_name, user_name, email, status FROM sys_user WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND del_flag = 0
SELECT user_id, login_name, user_name, email, status, password FROM sys_user WHERE login_name = #{loginName} AND del_flag = 0
SELECT user_id, login_name, user_name, email, status, password FROM sys_user WHERE login_name = #{loginName} AND del_flag = 0
SELECT user_id, login_name, user_name, email, status, password FROM sys_user WHERE user_name = #{username} AND del_flag = 0

SELECT DISTINCT m.perms FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.user_id JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_id = ur.role_id JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.role_id = r.role_id JOIN sys_menu m ON m.menu_id = rm.menu_id WHERE u.login_name = #{loginName} AND u.status = '0' AND r.status = '0' AND m.status = '0' AND u.del_flag = 0 AND m.menu_type IN ('C', 'F') AND m.perms IS NOT NULL AND m.perms != ''
